newsitem.title: USA: Boise Cascade Office expands in Canada.
newsitem.headline: Boise Cascade Office expands in Canada.

text.p: Boise Cascade Office Products Corp said Monday it acquired Quill Corp's Canadian customer list and will begin a Canadian direct marketing business through its subsidiary, Grand & Toy.
Quill, a privately held company based here, is a large direct marketer of office products in the United States that has decided to exit the Canadian market in order to focus on its U.S. operations.
Boise Cascade said its new Canadian operations will target small- and medium-sized businesses and home offices.

"The acquisition of Quill's list fits very well with our plans to begin the direct marketing of office products in Canada early next year," said Rick Black, President of Boise Cascade's direct marketing subsidiary, Reliable Corp.
Terms for the transaction and Quill's previous sales in its Canadian operations were not disclosed.
Boise Cascade is a large distributor of products for the office. It has operations in Australia, Canada, the United Kingdom, and the United States.
